description: Pupil context picker — pre-fill tool fields from a saved pupil record, and (opt-in) inject the pupil's recent records into the AI prompt. Adds <PupilContextPicker> at the top of every AIToolPage form when at least one pupil exists. Selecting a pupil auto-fills matching field IDs (initials, year group, sendNeed). Toggling 'Use recent records' on injects a structured summary of the pupil's last assignments + observations into the AI prompt context block — a defensible moat against generic ChatGPT.
steps: Create client/src/lib/pupil-context.ts with buildPupilContext(child) → { headline, promptBlock } and pupilToFormValues(child) → field ID map.
Create client/src/components/PupilContextPicker.tsx — a Card with a pupil select, 'Use recent records' switch, and a one-line headline.
In AIToolPage, render <PupilContextPicker> above the field grid when children.length > 0.
On pupil select, call pupilToFormValues and merge into form values (only fields the tool actually has).
When the toggle is ON, prepend buildPupilContext(child).promptBlock to the AI user prompt at generate time.
Default the toggle to OFF so a teacher must explicitly opt in to record injection.
acceptance_criteria: Picker appears only when at least one pupil exists.
Selecting a pupil pre-fills initials/year/sendNeed when the tool has those field IDs.
When the toggle is ON, the AI receives a [Pupil Records] context block prepended to the prompt.
When the toggle is OFF, no record data is sent.
verification: Manual: register a pupil with a recent assignment, open BehaviourPlan, pick the pupil, toggle ON, generate.
findings: buildPupilContext deliberately includes only data the school already authored (titles, year group, SEND needs). It never includes free-text descriptions to avoid leaking incidental PII.
